newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Britain optimistic on China talks over Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Britain optimistic on China talks over Hong Kong.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind said on Wednesday he wants to have "good and constructive talks" on Hong Kong with his Chinese counterpart later this week.
Speaking to reporters on arrival in Singapore for a series of meetings between Asian and European officials, Rifkind said: "The priority is to insure that Hong Kong's welfare is well advanced."
Rifkind declined to elaborate on what he would stress in his talks with Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen on the sidelines of the Asia-Europe meeting in Singapore on Friday.
But he appeared to rule out a role for the World Court in disputes regarding Britain's handover of the colony to China at midnight on June 30.
But, he added: "I want to have good and constructive discussions with Mr Qian Qichen."
